name: Nakura Yuri
source: Yui's older sister, Nakura Yuri joined FARGO a few months ago prior to the story due to traumatic experiences. She shows cold behavior towards her younger sister to the point of denying her existence.[spoiler] It was revealed that she was seeking the power offered by the organization to reunite her family but realized too late that it was useless for that.[/spoiler] Ultimately she died when the power she held in went out of control.
